message: The model did not respond in time. Try again; if this continues, ask an administrator to check the model connection.
The model service reached its request limit. Wait briefly and try again, or select another model.
The model service denied access. Ask an administrator to check the model credentials and project permissions.
The model budget is exhausted. Ask an administrator to check the project budget or provider billing before retrying.
The model service rejected this request. Check the selected model and its settings, or ask an administrator to inspect the execution logs.
The model returned an incomplete or invalid response. Try again or select another model. Report repeated failures to an administrator.
The model input exceeds the available context budget. Enable compaction, reduce attached content, or select a model with a larger context window.
The model request exceeds the transport size limit. Reduce attached content or tool results. A larger token window alone may not resolve this.
The model service could not be reached or is temporarily unavailable. Try again; ask an administrator to check the connection if it persists.
The model service reported an error while generating the response. Try again or select another model. An administrator can inspect the execution logs.
The run stopped because its output exceeded the delivery limit. Some results may be missing. Share the support reference with your administrator before repeating actions.
The pipeline stopped because a tool node has invalid input or a stale approval decision. Check its input mapping and restart only after reviewing completed actions.
The pipeline stopped because a tool node input exceeds its size limit. Reduce the mapped input or use smaller batches. This is not a model context limit.
The pipeline stopped because its selected tool cannot run. Check the toolkit binding, permissions, and supported operation. Share the support reference with your administrator.
A pipeline tool call failed. Later nodes did not run. Review the support reference and completed actions before retrying; the tool may have started work.
The pipeline stopped because a tool result does not match the node output mapping. Check the required fields and their types. Later nodes did not run.
The pipeline stopped because a tool result exceeds the node state size limit. Use smaller batches or reduce the returned data. Later nodes did not run.
